subject: Blade Runner 2099
title: Is Blade Runner 2099 a sequel? Yes, set 50 years after 2049
answer: Yes. "Blade Runner 2099" is a live-action sequel series set 50 years after "Blade Runner 2049" (2017), which itself followed Ridley Scott's 1982 original. All eight episodes of the limited series premiere on Prime Video on Nov. 25, 2026, starring Michelle Yeoh and Hunter Schafer.
body:
The series continues the same world rather than rebooting it. Amazon describes a Los Angeles 50 years after the events of "Blade Runner 2049," where replicants, the bioengineered humans of the films, now have the upper hand. Hunter Schafer plays Cora, a fugitive who takes on a new identity as a Blade Runner, and Michelle Yeoh plays Olwen, a replicant near the end of her life. The two are forced to work together to track down a runaway who knows a secret that could bring down their city.

It's an eight-episode limited series created by showrunner Silka Luisa, with Ridley Scott, who directed the original film, as an executive producer. Jonathan van Tulleken directed the first two episodes. The cast also includes Dimitri Abold and Lewis Gribben as series regulars, with Sheila Atim, Tom Burke, Daniel Rigby and Johnny Harris among the recurring guests. Filming took place in Prague in 2024 after plans to shoot in Northern Ireland were dropped following the 2023 writers' strike.

Do you need to watch the movies first? Not strictly, since the series follows new characters, but "Blade Runner 2049" gives the most useful background, and the 1982 film explains what replicants and Blade Runners are. No announcement has said Harrison Ford or Ryan Gosling appear. Both films are available to rent or buy on Prime Video.
in_the_news: Prime Video releases all eight episodes of "Blade Runner 2099" on Nov. 25, 2026.

faq.q: When does Blade Runner 2099 come out?
faq.a: Nov. 25, 2026, on Prime Video. Amazon hasn't announced an exact time; all eight episodes arrive at once.

faq.q: Is Harrison Ford in Blade Runner 2099?
faq.a: He is not in the announced cast, and neither is Ryan Gosling. The series follows new characters played by Hunter Schafer and Michelle Yeoh.

faq.q: How many episodes is Blade Runner 2099?
faq.a: Eight. It's billed as a limited series.

faq.q: Is Blade Runner 2099 based on a book?
faq.a: Not directly. The franchise began with Philip K. Dick's 1968 novel "Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?", but the series tells an original story.
